reference.title: WHO global air quality guidelines: particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), ozone, nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide and carbon monoxide
reference.note: Guideline only — not a regulatory limit.

parameterDefinition.name: PM2.5
parameterDefinition.description: Fine particulate matter mass concentration. 24-hour averages apply for 24h criterion.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: See WHO AQG 2021 section 3.2.3.1 (page 88) for method description.

criteria.methodNote: Defined as the 99th percentile of the annual distribution of 24-hour mean concentrations (equivalent to ~3–4 days exceedance/year). Source: WHO AQG 2021, section 3.2.3.1, p.88.

evidenceReference.quote: The PM2.5 guideline value for 24-hour mean concentrations is 15 µg/m³. This is defined as the 99th percentile of the annual distribution of 24-hour mean concentrations.

curation.curationNotes: Curated PM2.5 24h criterion from WHO AQG 2021; numeric threshold and method noted from provided evidence (section 3.2.3.1, p.88).

validation.validationNotes: Evidence aligns with WHO AQG 2021, section 3.2.3.1, p.88: PM2.5 24-hour guideline value = 15 µg/m³, defined as the 99th percentile of the annual distribution of 24-hour mean concentrations. Independent validation remains pending; therefore this record is not approved for use as a core criterion.
